semantics.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys. Canonicalize declared set-like arrays by stable identity: population_frame.group_ids, scenarios by scenario_id, each scenario.event_ids, service_requirements by requirement_id, functional_units by functional_unit_id, and design_revisions by subject_id. Other arrays retain declared order.
semantics.scope_digest: SHA-256 of the canonical scope JSON; digest is external and excluded from the scope payload.
semantics.payload_verification: The binder only checks content-digest syntax and identity. It never claims payload bytes verified; payload_bytes_verified is always false.
semantics.draft_schema: The only v0.1 owner registry artifact is a draft Mycelix Living-City schema. Bound means metadata matches the pinned draft artifact, not that the upstream draft is published or the payload is verified.
semantics.claim_ceiling: Synthetic scope and metadata binding only.
